passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should carefully review the following discussion of the risks that may affect our business, results of operations and financial condition, as well as our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto and the other information appearing in this report, for important information regarding risks that affect us. Current global economic and geopolitical events and conditions as well as evolving regulatory scrutiny may amplify many of these risks. These risks are not the only risks that may affect us. Additional risks that we are not aware of or do not believe are material at the time of this filing may also become important factors that adversely affect our business. Business, Economic and Operating Risks We experience significant variation in our operating and financial results, including GMV and net revenues. All of our GMV, and substantially all of our net revenues each quarter come from transactions involving sales during that quarter. As a result, it is inherently difficult to accurately forecast our GMV, the amount and sources of our net revenues, earnings (loss) per share, operating income (loss), and our other key operating and financial performance metrics. Our operating and financial results have significantly varied on a quarterly basis throughout our operating history, and we expect our results to continue to fluctuate significantly for a variety of reasons, including all of the risks described in “Risk Factors,” including the following: • our success in attracting and retaining sellers and buyers; • changes in consumer confidence and discretionary spending trends, including shifts in interests away from any of our major focus categories; • the success of our marketing efforts; • the impact of competition on our business and industry; • our ability to convert visits into sales for our sellers; • our success in executing on our strategy and the impact of any changes in our strategy; • the timing and success of product launches, including new services and features we may introduce; • the amount and timing of expenses; and • changes in the geopolitical, legal and regulatory landscape, and our response to those developments. In view of the rapidly evolving nature of our business and the factors discussed above, period-to-period comparisons of our operating and financial results may not be meaningful, and you should not rely upon them as an indication of future performance. We face intense competition that may materially harm our business. The businesses and markets in which we operate are intensely competitive. We compete with a wide and growing variety of online and offline businesses that provide similar goods and services across numerous industries and geographies in which we operate, including traditional retail, e-commerce, live commerce, advertising, search engines, social media, and AI-powered tools (such as agents and chatbots). credit_strengths.text: Operating margin sits comfortably above the sector median, reflecting the marketplace model's fee-based revenue mix and disciplined cost control; this supports internally funded debt service even as revenue growth outpaces operating income growth.

Interest coverage exceeds the sector median and improved year over year, with operating income covering gross interest expense many times over; the debt stack is modest relative to earnings power for a business of this scale.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage sit above sector medians, and the indicative profile is intermediate on the weaker of leverage and cash flow. Headroom to the next leverage band is thin, so modest EBITDA erosion or incremental borrowing could shift the profile.

Disclosed results vary significantly quarter to quarter because GMV and substantially all net revenue derive from transactions in the same quarter, and management warns period comparisons may not indicate future performance; intense competition across retail, e-commerce and AI-powered channels amplifies forecast risk.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure and dividends, but falls short of buybacks and total shareholder distributions; free cash flow covers dividends only. Shareholder returns therefore absorb more than internally generated cash, implying reliance on balance-sheet liquidity or refinancing.

Free cash flow to debt and operating cash flow to debt trail sector medians and weakened year over year, while the maturity ladder front-loads repayments in the near years against a sizable long-dated tail; refinancing execution and continued cash generation are the key servicing variables.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is supported by above-median margins and strong interest coverage, offset by leverage modestly above sector medians and cash conversion that lags peers. Our judgement is a stable, investment-grade-like profile, though the indicative intermediate risk band is not a rating.

Liquidity is adequate rather than ample: the current ratio is above one but below both the prior year and the sector median, and cash covers only part of gross debt. We would monitor distribution policy and near-term maturities as the main swing factors.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率穩居行業中位數之上，反映市場平台模式以費用為主的收入結構及嚴謹的成本控制；即使收入增長快於營業利潤增長，此舉仍支持以內部資金償付債務。
利息覆蓋率超過行業中位數並按年改善，營業利潤足以覆蓋總利息支出多倍；相對於此規模企業的盈利能力，債務結構尚屬溫和。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿均高於行業中位數，而指示性狀況在槓桿與現金流兩者中較弱一項上處於中等水平。距下一槓桿區間的緩衝空間有限，故EBITDA輕微侵蝕或新增借貸即可能改變狀況。
由於GMV及絕大部分淨收入均來自同一季度的交易，披露業績季度之間差異顯著，管理層警告期間比較未必預示未來表現；零售、電子商務及AI驅動渠道的激烈競爭放大預測風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流覆蓋資本開支及股息，但不足以覆蓋回購及股東分派總額；自由現金流僅覆蓋股息。因此股東回報所吸收的資金多於內部產生的現金，意味依賴資產負債表流動性或再融資。
自由現金流對債務及經營現金流對債務均落後行業中位數並按年轉弱，而到期結構在近年前置還款、長年期尾部規模可觀；再融資執行及持續現金產生為關鍵償付變數。

overall_credit_view.text: 信用狀況受高於中位數的利潤率及強勁利息覆蓋率支持，惟被略高於行業中位數的槓桿及落後同業的現金轉換所抵銷。我們的判斷為穩定、類投資級狀況，惟指示性中等風險區間並非評級。
流動性屬足夠而非充裕：流動比率高於一但低於去年及行業中位數，現金僅覆蓋部分總債務。我們將監察分派政策及近期到期債務作為主要擺動因素。
